decisions.reason: Removing Big Block prizes and changing the revenue allocation does not alter the Transak provider, fiat conversion, wallet provisioning, or mint destination.
The NFT remains an unlimited-mint ebook; the prize and revenue-allocation change does not affect its asset format or supply.
The optional gratuity feature and its preset or custom amounts are independent of the mandatory $30 revenue split and Big Block removal.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the required $8 purchase allocation to the continuing Small Block prize pool; no additional update or removal is required.
The approved FAQ still describes Big Block prizes and the former $8 founder share, so the client’s removal and revised $12/$10/$8 allocation necessarily require corresponding FAQ-copy changes.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Marcus, please remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $8 to me. The new breakdown should be:
$30 purchase, $12 to me, $10 to the affiliate, and $8 to the block prize pool.

That should improve my bottom line without materially affecting sales, while also making the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even arrangement between me and each community member, together with an equal opportunity to win the continuing $900 prizes, feels consistent with the project's ethos.

Explain one-time-email-code or SIWE access, automatic $10 referral commissions, Small Block prize-ticket assignment, winner notifications, automatic wallet payouts, fund-export guidance, and the confirmation email containing the mint number, NFT details, and dashboard link.
